nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) balances - token balance ledger of BasicToken
uint256 totalSupply_ - total token supply tracked in BasicToken
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed - ERC20 allowance ledger of StandardToken
address owner - privileged account set in Ownable constructor
address saleAgent - secondary privileged account in AdvancedOwnable
address internal managerAgent - privileged account in AdvancedOwnable
mapping(address => bool) blacklist - addresses blocked by BlackList
bool paused - emergency stop flag of Pausable
address TokenWalletHolder - initial holder of the whole supply in MainToken
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) - multiplication with overflow assert
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) - subtraction guarded by assert(b <= a)
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) - addition guarded by assert(c >= a)
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) - ERC20 transfer, overridden through BlackList/Pausable/SafeCheck layers
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) - ERC20 delegated transfer
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) - allowance setter, overridden by SafeApprove zero-check
increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue) - raises allowance
decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue) - lowers allowance
_burn(address _who, uint256 _value) internal - destroys balances and reduces totalSupply_
burn(uint256 _value) - burns caller's own tokens via _burn
burnFrom(address _from, uint256 _value) - burns using allowance then calls _burn
transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner - ownership handover
setSaleAgent(address newSaleAgent) public onlyOwner - updates saleAgent
setManagerAgent(address newManagerAgent) public onlyOwner - updates managerAgent
addAddressToBlacklist(address _address) public onlyOwnerOrManagerAgent - blacklists an account
removeAddressFromBlacklist(address _address) public onlyOwnerOrManagerAgent - unblacklists an account
pause() public onlyOwnerOrSaleAgent whenNotPaused - activates emergency stop
unpause() public onlyOwnerOrSaleAgent whenPaused - deactivates emergency stop
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, address _to, uint _value) public onlyOwner - sweeps foreign ERC20 tokens
MainToken(address _TokenWalletHolder) constructor - mints INITIAL_SUPPLY to TokenWalletHolder
function () public payable - rejects all plain ETH transfers with revert()
msg.sender - externally controlled caller used for authorization, balances and blacklist checks
accidentallyERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(_to,_value) - external call to an attacker-influenceable contract
c = a * b multiplication in SafeMath.mul - overflow surface mitigated by assert(c / a == b)
a - b subtraction in SafeMath.sub - underflow surface mitigated by assert(b <= a)
parameter _to - destination address of transfer/transferFrom/transferAnyERC20Token
parameter _value - token amount in transfer/transferFrom/approve/burn paths
parameter _from - source address in transferFrom/burnFrom
parameter _spender - allowance beneficiary address
parameter a - first operand of SafeMath helpers
parameter b - second operand of SafeMath helpers
parameter c - result of SafeMath.mul
parameter _who - account whose tokens are destroyed in _burn
parameter _address - account added to or removed from blacklist
parameter newOwner - incoming owner address
parameter newSaleAgent - incoming sale agent address
parameter newManagerAgent - incoming manager agent address
parameter _addedValue - allowance increment
parameter _subtractedValue - allowance decrement
local variable oldValue - cached allowance read in decreaseApproval
parameter _TokenWalletHolder - initial supply beneficiary in MainToken constructor
parameter tokenAddress - foreign ERC20 contract address targeted by the external call
